description: Missing runtime context (ciclo absent, even though consentimento_ativo/consent_checked are both asserted true): `receive` cannot assemble the idempotent business key nor verify consent for a concrete titular/scope, so it sets its own class-token error -- consent_gate treats inability-to-verify as NO consent (fail-closed), ignoring the (otherwise-looking-fine) consent facts entirely. Distinct code path from EVL-VALENTINA-01: there, receive succeeds and consent_gate itself computes ausente from the facts; here, receive's own guard fires first and consent_status stays ausente regardless of what the facts say.
